Hi Lisa —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear list. I pulled in Kimberly (Legal) and Jonas (Platform Ops) so we can triage quickly. High-level answers up front:

- Order form mapping: Redwood's portal connector supports separate Bill To vs Remit To fields; we can surface both in Ariba. We'll confirm the exact XML element names after we map to your sample export.
- PO ack SLA: our standard is 24–72 hours depending on the activation status. We can set a 48-hour SLA for this account and document it in the activation playbook.
- Invoice attachments: supported types are PDF, PNG, JPG; max 12 MB per attachment. If you need larger files we can route to SFTP ingest but that will add ~2 business days to provisioning.

Next steps I propose:
1) Jonas and I validate your column list against our OrderForm_Field_Map.xlsx and send a mapping back by EOD tomorrow.
2) Kimberly to confirm any MSA language that requires escalation to product/legal leadership (if we cannot accept the change as-is).
3) Quick 30-minute sync Thursday 9:30am PT to finalize enrollment window.

If that works, I'll attach a tracker after Jonas and I complete the mapping.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

- Kimberly: I will draft suggested LANGUAGE to propose a scoped retention that preserves auditability while honoring their regulatory ask. If exec signoff is required, I'll flag tomorrow morning.

Hi all —

Soojin and I ran the order form columns against our internal mapping. I've attached the working sheet (OrderForm_Field_Map.xlsx). Key notes:

- "BillToParty" maps to XML element /Order/Payment/BillToParty. "RemitTo" will be passed through as /Order/Payment/RemitToIdentifier.
- PO acknowledgement: we can set the ack policy for Harbor to 48 hours once activation is complete. Ops will emit a PO_ACK event into your webhook and also send an email ack if you prefer.
- Attachment handling: our portal will accept PDF, PNG, JPG up to 12 MB. Invoices over 12 MB will fail the ingest and notify vendor. We can implement SFTP fallback but that requires a supporting order in the activation tracker.

I've also created an activation tracker and added tentative dates for provisioning. See activation-tracker-harbor.xlsx. Marissa, please own the activation timeline once Kimberly confirms legal language.

Jonas Weber
Principal Platform Engineer
Redwood Inference
